system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Society and Intimidation, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Legal Lore, Court Procedure Lore, Local Government Lore.
system.description: You heard disputes and gave judgments that other people were expected to obey. You learned the workings of local law and how to hold a room's attention when a ruling pleased no one.
